2019 Volkswagen Golf R 4Motion: 6-Speed Manual, Tornado Red, DCC, Navigation, and 19-Inch Spielberg Wheels

This 2019 Volkswagen Golf R 4Motion is finished in Tornado Red over a Black/Titanium Black interior and pairs Volkswagen's turbocharged 2.0-liter engine with the enthusiast-favorite 6-speed manual transmission and 4Motion all-wheel drive.

Factory equipment includes Adaptive Chassis Control DCC, Driving Profile Selection, 19-inch Spielberg wheels, navigation, Vienna leather, premium sport seats, adaptive cruise control, Blind Spot Monitor, Lane Assist, LED lighting, front and rear parking sensors, and a rear-view camera.

For someone looking for a performance car that can genuinely serve as an everyday vehicle, the Golf R remains one of the most complete formulas available.

Manual, Turbocharged, and All-Wheel Drive

At the center of this Golf R is Volkswagen's 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder producing 215 kW, approximately 288 horsepower, paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

Power is delivered through Volkswagen's all-wheel-drive system, giving the Golf R the traction and all-weather capability that separate it from a conventional hot hatch.

The manual transmission is particularly important here. It provides a level of involvement that has become increasingly difficult to find in modern all-wheel-drive performance cars.

You get three pedals, turbocharged power, all-wheel-drive traction, and the practicality of a four-door hatchback.

Adaptive Chassis Control DCC

This car is equipped with Adaptive Chassis Control DCC with Driving Profile Selection.

DCC allows the suspension behavior to change depending on the selected driving mode, giving the Golf R a wider range of personalities than a fixed-suspension performance car.

It can remain comfortable enough for commuting and longer trips while offering a firmer, more responsive setup when the road becomes interesting.

Combined with the Golf R's progressive steering, electronic differential control, sport suspension hardware, and all-wheel-drive system, the result is a car designed to deliver performance without sacrificing everyday usability.

Tornado Red and Spielberg Wheels

Tornado Red is an ideal color for the Golf R, giving the understated hatchback shape significantly more presence without becoming excessive.

The exterior is complemented by factory 19-inch Spielberg alloy wheels with a diamond-turned finish, black mirror housings, R-specific bumpers and sill extensions, a body-color rear spoiler, and the Golf R's signature quad exhaust outlets.

Black brake calipers with R logos complete the performance-oriented exterior.

A Proper Everyday Performance Car

One of the Golf R's biggest strengths is how much equipment and practicality are packed into a relatively compact package.

Factory equipment includes:

6-speed manual transmission
4Motion all-wheel drive
Adaptive Chassis Control DCC
Driving Profile Selection
Progressive steering

This is the appeal of the Golf R in one package: serious performance hardware without sacrificing the features expected of a comfortable daily driver.

The history is particularly useful because it documents several significant maintenance and repair items rather than leaving them unknown.

Documented Service History

Autohaus of Peoria performed early servicing, with documented maintenance inspections, oil changes, tires, and other routine work.

In 2021, CARFAX records replacement of the front struts, and the car also received four new tires during that period.

More significant work appears later in the history.

In 2022 and 2023, Smart Luxury Motors documented service including:

Maintenance inspections
Brake-fluid service
Oil and filter changes
Clutch replacement
Flywheel/flexplate replacement
Transmission inspection
Drivability and performance checks

In February 2024, the vehicle returned to Smart Luxury Motors for substantial engine work. CARFAX records:

Maintenance inspection
Cylinder head gasket replacement
Cylinder head replacement
Engine/powertrain computer and module check

These are meaningful services for a used performance car, and their presence on the CARFAX provides useful documentation of work already performed.

Later history includes another oil service and inspection in December 2024. In April 2025, the vehicle received an ignition coil replacement, oil and filter change, emissions inspection, safety inspection, and wiper replacement before being offered for sale in California.

The car later came to Response Motors, where it was serviced in October 2026 before being offered for sale.

Why This Golf R Stands Out

This 2019 Golf R stands out for its Tornado Red paint, 6-speed manual, turbocharged power, all-wheel drive, DCC, 19-inch Spielberg wheels, Vienna leather, navigation, and an extensive driver-assistance package.

The CARFAX history also offers unusually clear insight into the car's mechanical history.

Major items, including the clutch, flywheel, cylinder head, and head gasket, are documented as replaced, along with continued routine servicing afterward.

For an enthusiast looking for one car that can commute, carry passengers and cargo, handle poor weather, and still deliver a genuinely engaging manual driving experience, the Golf R remains difficult to beat.

Its folding rear seat, hatchback cargo area, concealed storage, and cargo cover provide flexible space for groceries, luggage, and commuting essentials. All-weather liners, door-sill protectors, and a rear bumper applique help guard against daily wear.

Connected features include cloud-based navigation, real-time traffic information, Bluetooth, streaming audio, voice controls, and available Wi-Fi connectivity. The 120-volt interior outlet provides convenient power for compatible devices.

Advanced driver-assistance technology includes Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Tracing Assist, Traffic Jam Assist, forward-collision mitigation, blind-spot monitoring, intersection support, driver monitoring, and parking sensors with automatic braking.

If you're comparing a used Toyota Prius Plug-in Hybrid with the standard Prius Hybrid, Hyundai IONIQ Plug-in Hybrid, Kia Niro PHEV, Ford Escape Plug-in Hybrid, or other efficient commuter vehicles, this 2026 Prius PHEV SE offers an appealing combination of electric capability, gasoline flexibility, advanced safety, and hatchback versatility.

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. 2024 Honda Civic Performance and Engine

A Manual Civic in 2024 — Still a Thrill

description: SPORTY, STYLISH, FUN-TO-DRIVE, LOW-MILEAGE, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, THE HATCHBACK THAT DOES IT ALL! Few nameplates have earned the loyalty of drivers the way the Honda Civic has, and the Civic Hatchback brings that reputation together with a sportier look and a far more flexible cargo area. This 2024 Honda Civic Hatchback Sport Touring, finished in Crystal Black Pearl and showing just over 18,700 miles, is the top of the hatchback lineup, packed with the comfort and technology features that make an everyday commute feel like a treat. Crystal Black Pearl is a deep, glossy black with a subtle pearl shimmer that gives the Civic's sculpted lines a sharp, upscale look. Add a one-owner, off-lease history, regular oil changes on CARFAX, and factory coverage that still has time and miles remaining, and this Civic makes an easy case for itself. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Civic Hatchback occupies a sweet spot that few vehicles can match. It drives with the agility and efficiency of a compact car, yet the hatchback body opens up 24.5 cubic feet of cargo space, enough for four full-size suitcases with room to spare, and the rear seats fold down when you need even more room. Reviewers have called it an affordable intersection of form, function, and fun, a description that fits the way it blends practicality with a genuine sense of enjoyment behind the wheel. Honda's reputation adds to the appeal. The Civic is known for thoughtful engineering, a comfortable and well-organized cabin, and a broad dealer network that makes ownership simple. For shoppers who want a stylish, efficient hatchback without giving up features, the Sport Touring is the trim that delivers the most. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Capital One's review of the 2024 Civic Hatchback praised its turbocharged engine and its spirited yet refined acceleration. The reviewer noted that the Sport Touring model excels on winding roads, with impressive grip and predictable behavior that builds driver confidence, and highlighted the balance Honda strikes between ride comfort and body control. The review also praised the cabin's quality materials and intuitive controls, along with the hatchback's generous cargo space. Reviewers do note that highway noise can be noticeable and that the Civic Hatchback is not offered with all-wheel drive, which are common trade-offs in this class. For most shoppers, they are small compromises for a hatchback that is this engaging to drive. Warranty With 18,724 miles on the odometer and CARFAX showing regular oil changes, this Civic is STILL COVERED by the remainder of Honda's factory protection, which transfers to the next retail owner. Remaining transferable factory coverage: New Vehicle Limited Warranty: 3 years or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. Based on the June 24, 2024 warranty start date, this coverage runs through June 24, 2027, with roughly 17,200 miles of allowance remaining. Powertrain Limited Warranty: 5 years or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first, covering the engine, transmission, and drivetrain components. This coverage runs through June 24, 2029, with roughly 41,200 miles of allowance remaining. For buyers who want protection beyond the remaining factory coverage, extended service plans are available for purchase. Standard Features The Sport Touring is the top of the Civic Hatchback lineup, and it is loaded with the touches that make everyday driving more enjoyable. Leather-trimmed seating, heated front seats, and an eight-way power driver's seat make the cabin feel a class above, while dual-zone automatic climate control lets the driver and front passenger each choose their own temperature. A 12-speaker Bose premium audio system, a 9-inch touchscreen with built-in navigation, and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto round out the package, giving the Sport Touring the kind of technology that is usually reserved for more expensive vehicles. Mechanical Features Power comes from Honda's 1.5-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, which produces 180 horsepower and 177 lb-ft of torque. Turbocharging delivers its torque low in the rev range, so the Civic feels quick and lively around town and has confident passing power on the highway, and it does so with impressive efficiency. The EPA rates the Civic Hatchback Sport Touring at 30 mpg city, 38 mpg highway, and 33 mpg combined. A continuously variable transmission keeps the engine in its most efficient range and delivers smooth, seamless acceleration, and the Civic's balanced chassis and well-tuned suspension are what give it the grip and predictable handling reviewers praise. It is a compact hatchback that rewards a spirited drive on a twisty road while remaining calm and composed on a daily commute. Exterior Features Crystal Black Pearl is a deep, rich black with a fine pearl flake that catches the light and shows off the Civic Hatchback's sculpted lines. It gives this Civic a sophisticated, sporty presence that looks just as good in the office parking lot as it does on a weekend drive. The hatchback body gives the Civic a sleek, athletic profile, and the Sport Touring rides on 18-inch alloy wheels that fill the wheel arches and give the car a planted, confident stance. LED lighting and a clean, modern design complete the look. Interior Features Inside, the Civic Hatchback feels more premium than its class might suggest. Leather-trimmed seats, heated front seats, and an eight-way power driver's seat help the driver find a comfortable position for long drives, and dual-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable in every season. Practicality is where the hatchback shines. The cargo area offers 24.5 cubic feet of space, enough for four full-size suitcases, and the folding rear seats let you expand that space when you need to carry bikes, furniture, or gear, making the Civic a truly flexible everyday companion. Infotainment & Technology The Sport Touring's 9-inch touchscreen puts navigation, music, and phone functions right at your fingertips, with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto so your phone connects without a cable the moment you get in. The interface is clean and intuitive, with large icons that make it easy to use on the go. A 12-speaker Bose premium audio system fills the cabin with rich, detailed sound, turning every commute or road trip into a concert of your own choosing. Safety Features Honda Sensing is standard, bringing a suite of driver-assistance technologies to every Civic. Collision Mitigation Braking helps detect a potential frontal collision and applies the brakes if the driver does not respond in time, Adaptive Cruise Control eases the strain of highway commuting, and Lane Keeping Assist and Road Departure Mitigation help keep the vehicle on its intended path. Blind Spot Information gives additional confidence when changing lanes, and a rearview camera with dynamic guidelines makes backing into tight spaces easier. Together with a comprehensive airbag system, these features give drivers extra peace of mind on every trip. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Civic Hatchback delivers the things compact shoppers love most: a peppy turbocharged engine, impressive fuel economy, a roomy and flexible hatchback cabin, and the premium touches of the Sport Touring trim, including leather-trimmed heated seats, navigation, and a 12-speaker Bose audio system. With low mileage, a one-owner, off-lease history, regular oil changes on CARFAX, and factory coverage still in place, it is a smart, easy-to-love way to enjoy a hatchback with real personality. This Civic is ready to turn every commute into something you look forward to.
